pages.title: What Chest is
pages.summary: Your team's files in spaces and folders, shared, searchable and kept in every version, on a Chest you run.

pages.title: Run Chest on your computer
pages.summary: Get Chest and start it with one line, then finish first-run setup.

pages.title: Set up Chest
pages.summary: Invite your staff and make team spaces; add groups, and the Library's collections and types if you need sign-off.

pages.title: Folders and files
pages.summary: Team spaces and folders, uploads that resume, search, and going back to an earlier version or date.

pages.title: Share files and folders
pages.summary: Share with colleagues and groups, make a link for anyone with a password, expiry and download limit, or ask for files with a file request.

pages.title: Text inside files and scans
pages.summary: How Chest reads PDFs, Office files, scans and photos so search finds the words inside, and how values read from a scan are accepted.

pages.title: Work with external guests
pages.summary: PIN verification, uploads, retained versions and the Collabora editor for named guests.

pages.title: File and find documents
pages.summary: Upload a record to the Library, file it with a type, an owner and a relationship, then search, preview and download.

pages.title: Versions and approval
pages.summary: Submit a replacement, review the exact version, and see what stays current while you decide.

pages.title: People and access
pages.summary: Grant reader, editor and reviewer roles on Library records to people and groups, keep a record private, and remove access everywhere at once.

pages.title: Review and expiry dates
pages.summary: Schedule reviews and expiries, see what is due, and record who checked it with evidence.

pages.title: Trash and the audit trail
pages.summary: Move a record to reversible trash, restore it, and read every change in the audit trail.

sections.title: Move in and keep it safe

pages.title: Move in from Google Drive, Dropbox or Box
pages.summary: Download your files from Google Drive, Dropbox or Box, or choose a folder, and bring them into Chest with their folders.

pages.title: Backup and restore
pages.summary: Export everything to one file and restore it into a fresh Chest.

pages.title: Content security
pages.summary: Quarantine, classification, separately deployed scanning and scoped mass-activity alerts.

pages.title: Host Chest on Cloudflare
pages.summary: Deploy to your own Cloudflare account, choose the mail provider and sender, sign in, back up, restore and remove.
